regions.name: Borneo
regions.quote: All members of the genus are endemic to Borneo with over half restricted to just a single river basin or sub-basin.

regions.name: Mount Kinabalu
regions.quote: The type series was collected from 'Mount Kina-Balou, headwaters of Tampassuk River, Sabah, Borneo', and in fact all its native rivers drain Mount Kinabalu, one of the world's most important biological sites with incredibly high levels of local species endemism.
